note: deltaB = first-year change to the deficit, $B; positive reduces the deficit. Mostly 10-year scores divided by 10 (CBO 'Options for Reducing the Deficit', Dec 2024, unless noted). Approximate. households = rough annual $ change for each archetype (+ = better off).

policies.label: Roll back the One Big Beautiful Bill (2025)
policies.source: Restores pre-2025 law: TCJA brackets/deduction/CTC expire, no tips/overtime/senior deductions, Medicaid & SNAP cuts reversed. Total = CBO's FY2026 score (~$487B); the tax pieces are modeled directly, the rest is a lump sum.

policies.label: Tax carried interest as ordinary income
+$10B/yr IRS enforcement
policies.source: CBO (net of cost; ramps up over time)

policies.label: Eliminate the federal diesel tax (24.4¢/gal)
policies.source: Tax Policy Center: diesel excise raised ~$10.8B (FY2023). An Oct 2026 executive order defers it through Dec 31; this makes it permanent.

policies.label: Repeal the remaining 2025 tariffs
policies.source: MTS FY2026: net customs $173B vs ~$80B before 2025 (gross $318B less $145B refunded after the IEEPA tariffs were struck down)

policies.label: Use chained CPI for SS cost-of-living raises
Raise full retirement age to 70 (phased in)
policies.source: CBO Options (small at first; large long-run savings)

policies.label: Per-capita caps on federal Medicaid funding
Freeze federal civilian pay for one year
Expand CTC to 2021 levels, fully refundable
Universal pre-K
policies.source: Approx. (2021 Build Back Better proposal, annualized)

policies.label: Defense budget to $1.5 trillion
policies.source: FY2027 request: ~$1.15T base + $350B via reconciliation. Scored as outlays rising from FY2026's $965B; real outlays would ramp up over several years.

policies.label: Medicare for All
policies.source: Urban Institute (2019): ~$34T more federal spending over 10 years. Unfunded here; households would also stop paying premiums (not shown).

policies.label: Forgive $10k–$20k of student debt
policies.source: CBO (2022): ~$400B one-time cost. Struck down by the Supreme Court in 2023.

policies.label: Buffett Rule: 30% minimum tax on $1M+ incomes
policies.source: JCT (2012): ~$47B over 10 years, scaled up for income growth.

policies.label: 50¢/gal gas tax increase
policies.source: Scaled from CBO's 15¢ option (~$22B/yr), allowing for lower demand.

policies.label: 'Penny Plan': cut all non-interest spending 1%
policies.source: 1% of FY2026 non-interest outlays (~$6.3T). The plan repeats the cut every year.

policies.label: Abolish the income tax, replace it with tariffs
policies.source: Loses $2.85T of individual income tax. Clausing & Obstfeld (2024) put the revenue-maximizing tariff at ~$780B/yr. Household effects not shown.

policies.label: Pay the remaining IEEPA tariff refunds
policies.source: ~$166B in IEEPA duties plus interest must be refunded after V.O.S. Selections v. US (Feb 2026); ~$145B was refunded in FY2026 (MTS).

policies.label: Roll back DOGE cuts
policies.source: Low confidence. Independent estimates of DOGE's verifiable net savings: ~$1-7B (B. Stevenson), ~$2B verified (NPR), ~$5.5B (OpenFeds); GAO-26-108615 could trace only 43% of claimed contract savings. Midpoint used. Excludes possible lost IRS revenue from staff cuts (estimates unverified).
